description: Java class 'RecordIterator' for reading large data files with support for fixed-length and delimited records, including handling of parent-child record relationships.

classes.name: RecordIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for reading and parsing large data files with support for fixed-length and delimited formats, including nested record handling.

methods.name: RecordIterator
methods.description: Constructor initializing with URL and ModelDataFile, opens stream from URL.

methods.name: RecordIterator
methods.description: Constructor initializing with InputStream, ModelDataFile, and location info.

methods.name: setupStream
methods.description: Prepares BufferedReader with specified InputStream and charset, skips start lines.

methods.name: getNextLine
methods.description: Reads the next line or fixed-length record from the stream, updates nextRecord.

methods.name: getCurrentLineNumber
methods.description: Returns current line number in the file.

methods.name: hasNext
methods.description: Checks if there are more records to read.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Returns the next Record object, handling parent-child relationships.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the BufferedReader and underlying stream.

methods.name: findModelForLine
methods.description: Determines the ModelRecord for a given line based on type code or range.
